2607.12422.title: Accepted Prefixes Are Not All You Need: A Negative Result on PEFT-Based Block-Diffusion Drafting
2607.12422.paper_summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language model inference by using a cheap drafter to propose multiple future tokens and a target model to verify them. A common design goal is therefore to improve draft quality while reducing auxiliary parameters and systems overhead. We study a negative result for this direction through PEFT-BD, a same-backbone speculative decoding method in which a LoRA-like adapter acts as a block-diffusion drafter for an autoregressive verifier. PEFT-BD is motivated by several attractive properties: it avoids tokenizer mismatch, avoids loading a separate draft model, adds only a small number of trainable parameters, and uses a BD3LM-style denoising objective to propose a block of tokens in parallel. Despite these advantages, PEFT-BD does not yield a practical speedup in our Qwen3-0.6B experiments. Although the method obtains nontrivial accepted prefixes, profiling shows that each speculative step requires an adapter-enabled full-backbone draft pass followed by an adapter-disabled full-backbone verification pass. Thus, the drafter is parameter-efficient but not compute-efficient. Our results isolate a simple but important condition for successful speculative decoding: the drafter must be substantially cheaper to execute than the verifier. Longer accepted prefixes alone cannot compensate when draft computation remains verifier-scale.
2607.12422.paper_summary_zh: 推測解碼通過使用廉價的草擬器來提出多個未來標記，並使用目標模型來驗證它們，從而加速自回歸語言模型的推理。因此，一個常見的設計目標是提高草稿質量，同時減少輔助參數和系統開銷。我們通過PEFT-BD研究了這個方向的一個負面結果，這是一種相同骨幹的推測解碼方法，其中一個類似LoRA的適配器充當自回歸驗證器的區塊擴散草擬器。PEFT-BD的動機來自幾個吸引人的特性：它避免了標記器不匹配，避免了加載單獨的草擬模型，僅增加少量可訓練參數，並使用BD3LM風格的去噪目標來並行提出一組標記。儘管這些優勢，PEFT-BD在我們的Qwen3-0.6B實驗中並未帶來實際的加速。儘管該方法獲得了非平凡的接受前綴，但分析顯示每個推測步驟需要一個啟用適配器的完整骨幹草擬通過，然後是禁用適配器的完整骨幹驗證通過。因此，草擬器在參數上是高效的，但在計算上並不高效。我們的結果隔離了一個簡單但重要的條件，以實現成功的推測解碼：草擬器的執行成本必須顯著低於驗證器。僅僅更長的接受前綴無法彌補當草擬計算仍然保持在驗證器規模時的情況。
2607.12422.author: Abdurrahman Javat et.al.
